definitions.explanation: The formal ceremony held at the start of an event such as a sports tournament, school athletic festival, conference, or international competition. Typically includes speeches, parading of participants, and an official declaration that the event has begun.

examples.japanese: {開会式|かいかいしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧⟦{九|く}{時|じ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The opening ceremony starts at 9 a.m.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開会式|かいかいしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched the Olympic opening ceremony on TV.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開会式|かいかいしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{校長先生|こうちょうせんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the opening ceremony of the sports day, the principal gave a speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開会式|かいかいしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{各|かく}{国|こく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選手団|せんしゅだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧し、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: At the tournament's opening ceremony, the national teams entered in turn and were enveloped in loud cheers.

notes:
{開会式|かいかいしき} combines ⟦{開会|かいかい}→開会：04118_kaikai⟧ (opening of a meeting/event) and {式|しき} (ceremony, formal event). It is the standard term for the opening ceremony of any organized event, from school sports days to the Olympics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開会式|かいかいしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold an opening ceremony
- {開会式|かいかいしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend an opening ceremony
- {開会式|かいかいしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}する→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧: to give a speech at the opening ceremony
- {開会式|かいかいしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{司会|しかい}→司会：00364_shikai⟧: master of ceremonies for the opening ceremony

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{閉会式|へいかいしき}→閉会式：26936_heikaishiki⟧: closing ceremony — held at the end of the same kind of event

USAGE:
- ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開会式|かいかいしき}: opening ceremony of a school sports day
- ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開会式|かいかいしき}: Olympic opening ceremony
- ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開会式|かいかいしき}: opening ceremony of an academic conference
- ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開会式|かいかいしき}: tournament opening ceremony

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧: parade of entry (a typical part of an opening ceremony)
